subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The project showed that good design listens to behavior.”?
options: Sometimes it is a harsh sound that reminds people of labor, discipline, and the lives behind the products a town was built on.
Instead of only telling people where to walk, the city studied where people already walked and built a better way.
A badge can mark the path walked, but the skill must still be built in the hands and mind.
When old infrastructure loses its first purpose, it may still guide people through history in a new way.
